title: Closing Period of a Security Deposit Refund: Opening Rate
content:
**Closing period.** The closing period of a Security Deposit refund runs from the period end of the latest interest credit on the deposit, or from the fully secured date when none has been credited, to the refund date.

**Opening rate.** The closing period's opening rate is 4.02% (0.0402) when the period began in 2025, 3.85% (0.0385) when it began in 2024, and 4.17% (0.0417), the annual interest rate of every Security Deposit kind, otherwise.

| Closing period began in | Opening rate |
|---|---|
| Calendar 2025 | 4.02% |
| Calendar 2024 | 3.85% |
| Any other calendar year | 4.17% |

## Cases (hypothetical deposits)

| Deposit record | Closing period began | Opening rate |
|---|---|---|
| Latest interest credit with period end 18 November 2025 | 18 November 2025 | 4.02% |
| No interest credit; fully secured on 2 September 2024 | 2 September 2024 | 3.85% |
| Latest interest credit with period end 6 March 2026 | 6 March 2026 | 4.17% |
